description: Verify that suspendInterface — DUT emits StopOfferService then re-offers same ports
approach:
[Objective]
Service suspend/resume cycle: suspendInterface stops the offer (StopOfferService entry); resume re-offers the same endpoint (port preservation invariant).

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester (UT) → DUT: suspendInterface → DUT → Tester: StopOfferService.
3. Tester (UT) → DUT: resume → DUT → Tester: OfferService with same port.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase3_no_resume_offer: No resume OfferService within listen window
